# Embedded-Dolt cmd/bd test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# 100-shard split for the Bazel-only embedded-Dolt cmd tier
# (bazel-embedded in .github/workflows/bazel.yml), bin-packed
# longest-first by measured wall-time from
# scripts/ci/embedded_cmd_test_durations.json (see that file for provenance
# and its "relative weight, not absolute SLA" caveat) onto the shard
# whose estimated wall time grows least: serial tests (no top-level
# t.Parallel) add up, parallel ones share -test.parallel=4.
# Regenerate with scripts/ci/gen_embedded_cmd_shard_manifest.py 100
# --weights=duration --write after adding, splitting or removing
# TestEmbedded* functions in cmd/bd/*_embedded_test.go. --write is
# incremental: it keeps every already-assigned test on its current shard
# and only places newly-discovered names, onto whichever shard is
# currently lightest, so two unrelated PRs that each add one test do not
# textually conflict or silently invalidate each other's packing. Pass
# --repack to force a full from-scratch rebalance instead (a deliberate,
# separate change — expect a large diff). --check only verifies every
# discovered name is listed here exactly once (no stale or duplicate
# entries); it does NOT verify the packing is still well-balanced.
#
# This file is generated: notes added here are erased by the next
# regeneration. Add them to the generator or the durations file instead.
